import os
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from server import respond


class Health(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reports_revision_from_environment(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"APP_REVISION": "abc123"}):
            self.assertEqual(respond("/health"), (200, {"status": "ok", "revision": "abc123"}))

    def test_falls_back_to_development_when_unset(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ):
            os.environ.pop("APP_REVISION", None)
            self.assertEqual(respond("/health"), (200, {"status": "ok", "revision": "development"}))

    def test_query_string_ignored(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"APP_REVISION": "r"}):
            self.assertEqual(respond("/health?x=1")[0], 200)

    def test_sum_and_unknown_unaffected(self):
        self.assertEqual(respond("/sum?a=2&a=3"), (200, {"sum": 5}))
        self.assertEqual(respond("/nope"), (404, {"error": "not found"}))
EOF
